body:
创建一个gif，按照附图的动作顺序生成。

【制作适配：本次输出】上文只定义动作和造型。本次只输出一张PNG精灵图，严格4列×3行，共12格，左到右、上到下按时间排列，每格同样大小。不是GIF文件。不要边框、格线、边距、序号、时间码；除指定字幕外不要新增文字。所有格固定机位、角色大小、地面基线和配色，角色和动作不超出单格。连续帧有清晰不同的姿态，之后逐格编码为GIF。
遵循输入动作表的12个动作顺序，固定角色大小、地面线和篮筐位置。不能把动作表本身画在某一格里。每格只有完整场景的一帧。

en.title: Basketball dunk sequence — composed GIF
en.description: 12 frames, 1.8 seconds, 362×362px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.
en.body:
## How to use

Upload the 1 project-generated reference image(s) in the displayed order (R09-action), then use the complete adapted prompt.

Generate one PNG sheet, extract 12 cells in row-major order, and encode them with the recorded delays and loop setting. The GIF is composed locally; the image tool returned a still PNG. The source sheet, exact crops, frame delays and first-frame poster are retained in the campaign archive.

## Result and limitations

12 frames, 1.8 seconds, 362×362px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.

Twelve returned poses follow the ordered input chart: preparation, jump, turn, raise, dunk, hang, release and landing. Character and hoop positions stay readable; actual 1800 ms loop. The ball returns to the ready hand at the loop reset without a separate pickup transition; document this keyframe limitation.

## Source

Adapted by Prompt Seen from [@crayon1267's original prompt](https://x.com/crayon1267/status/2118186300339892472). The author labels the source work Image 2.6; this run only establishes the GPT Image family, with no exact model ID. The prompt preserves its submitted language on both page editions. Likes describe the whole source post, shared by variants, and are not engagement for this example.

zh-Hans.title: 篮球扣篮动作 · 合成 GIF
zh-Hans.description: 12 帧，1.8 秒，362×362 像素，无限循环；GPT Image 精灵图逐格裁切并在本地编码为 GIF。
zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

按显示顺序上传 1 张本站生成的参考图（R09-action），使用完整改编词。

先生成单张 PNG 精灵图，按行优先提取 12 格，以记录的停留时长和循环设置编码为 GIF。生图工具返回静态 PNG；GIF 由本地合成。原精灵图、裁切坐标、逐帧时长与首帧封面均保存在批次档案。

## 结果与限制

12 帧，1.8 秒，362×362 像素，无限循环；GPT Image 精灵图逐格裁切并在本地编码为 GIF。

按 12 格动作表依次重绘；循环时篮球由地面直接复位到手上，缺少捡球过渡。

## 来源

由 Prompt Seen 根据 [@crayon1267 的原词](https://x.com/crayon1267/status/2118186300339892472)改编。来源作者称原作品使用 Image 2.6；本次仅确认 GPT Image 家族，精确型号未知。中英文页面保留同一实际提交正文。点赞属于整篇来源帖，同帖变体共享统计对象，不属于本站新作品。
